script.base: Books have DEN -4.5 with a 44.5 total, implied DEN 24.5 / ARI 20.0: a moderate DEN lead, not a blowout and not a shootout. Denver closes on J.K. Dobbins (46 carries, 149 yards in weeks 4-6) while Arizona, a 4.5 dog with Jeremiyah Love out, throws to stay in it through Trey McBride (31 targets, 150 yards) and Michael Wilson. Pace stays ordinary because 44.5 does not force a track meet.
script.flip1: DEN scores early, kills the clock with Dobbins, and Nix/Waddle/Sutton yardage stalls the way a favorite's passing stalls in a 38-21 script; ARI abandons Allgeier/Knight and the comeback throws get shortened late, so ARI skill unders and DEN WR unders cash together.
script.flip2: Shootout or a hang-around ARI: the Cardinals' secondary (YPA left 8.84, middle 8.27, right 8.67; 19 passes of 20+) plus Melton/Baker questionable lets Waddle and Sutton finally convert their air yards, and correlated overs hit; or DEN's 37% blitz (ARI EPA/play -0.24 when blitzed vs +0.11 clean) plus a Beck/Brissett hiccup turns it into a slog under 44.5.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game report, not inactives: ARI RB Jeremiyah Love Out (Ankle) pushes his weeks 4-6 load (26 carries, 85 yards) toward Tyler Allgeier (29/87) and Z.Knight/Bam Knight (16/88; Bam last4 rush 24, 8, 80), but those lines are unpriced or still coin-flip, so no forced sleeper leg. ARI DT Walter Nolen Out and Darius Robinson Questionable soften the front Dobbins would run at; G Jon Gaines II Out raises ARI pressure risk and quick-throw rate. S Andrew Wingard Out, Budda Baker Questionable and CB Max Melton Questionable are the secondary flags for DEN WRs, and they cut against DEN receiving unders if they sit. QB Carson Beck Questionable; the weeks 4-6 rush sample is Jacoby Brissett (8/39), so Beck is not a priced edge. DEN S Talanoa Hufanga Out and LB Jonah Elliss Out help ARI's short/middle (McBride, Higgins) more than outside deep. CB Pat Surtain II Questionable is the Wilson swing and is unresolved, so Wilson is not a leg. DEN RB Tyler Badie Out (4 carries, 3 targets in the L3) is a small bump to Dobbins/Harvey. Jonah Coleman Questionable (Ankle) with one listed game of 39 rush yards makes his 18.5 a game-time guess, not a read. Final inactives are not in the pack.

matchup.shell: No coverage charting, MOFO/MOFC or man/zone rate in the pack. Location splits only: ARI allows YPA left 8.84 (64), middle 8.27 (45), right 8.67 (63). DEN allows left 6.86 (69), middle 9.1 (41), right 5.34 (100). Shell read is limited.
matchup.pressure: ARI blitzes 28%; DEN EPA/play is -0.27 vs blitz and -0.04 vs none, so Arizona does not force the checkdown script. DEN blitzes 37%; ARI EPA/play is -0.24 vs blitz and +0.11 vs none, so Denver pressure is the scheme lever: it should cut deep WR yards (Wilson 310 air yards in weeks 4-6) and feed short targets.
matchup.bleeds: ARI bleeds every passing location and has 19 passes of 20+ (186) plus 4.45 rush YPC and 19 runs of 10+ in six games, with Nolen out. DEN bleeds the middle (9.1 YPA) and the run (4.83 YPC, 24 runs of 10+), and is stout to the right (5.34). Explosives allowed: DEN 15 passes of 20+ (228).
matchup.overlap: DEN's target leader is Jaylen Waddle (18 targets, only 78 yards on 102 air) into a secondary that gives up 8.3-8.8 YPA everywhere — that overlap is an over environment, not a clamp, and it conflicts with the form under. The clean overlap is ARI's short game into DEN's middle bleed and blitz: Elijah Higgins (8 targets, 104 yards, only 31 air yards in weeks 4-6) and McBride (31 targets, 173 air) attack the area DEN just lost a safety and a linebacker in. Sutton's 152 air yards on 41 yards do not overlap a weak DEN outside; Wilson's 310 air yards overlap the strong right side unless Surtain sits.

form: Weeks 4-6 plus listed last4, not season averages. Dobbins rush last4 49, 40, 68, 41 on 46 carries / 149 yards (3.24 YPC) — volume without efficiency, sitting on 48.5. Harvey is the receiving back (15 targets, 99 yards, -32 air; rush+rec last4 47, 93, 7, 56) with a 7-yard dud. Waddle last4 receiving 10, 35, 19, 24, none within 16 yards of 51.5, on 18 targets / 78 yards. Sutton last4 46, 4, 18, 19 with 152 air and 41 yards in the L3 — one explosive, then a slump. Engram 0, 6, 55, 13. ARI: McBride 75, 31, 66, 53 vs a 62 number and a 50-yard L3 pace; Wilson 89, 95, 30, 32, bipolar; Bourne 11, 22, 70, 47; Higgins 20, 19, 57, 28, all clear of 12.5, with the 57 looking like one chunk play; Allgeier rush+rec 9, 49, 16, 48 and rush -1, 42, 7, 38 while splitting with Love, who is now out. Nix rush last4 7, 10, 10, 3, all under 10.5 but glued to the number. Zonovan Knight has no prior games; Bam Knight 24, 8, 80.

McBride 62, Dobbins rush+rec 58, Knight 38.5/43 and several alts have no two-sided price.
pro_edge.sleepers: Love Out is the skill-position sleeper: Allgeier rushrec 47.5 is still no-vig over 0.505, rush yards 32 is unpriced, Bam Knight 43 and Zonovan Knight 38.5 are unpriced (Zonovan has no prior games). Illiquid and low confidence; dog-abandons-run fights an Allgeier over, so no sleeper leg. Badie Out is only 4 carries and 3 targets in the L3; Dobbins 48.5 no-vig over is 0.490, not a stale bump. Coleman is Questionable, not Out. Wingard, Nolen, Hufanga and Elliss Out are cross-unit and used in the matchup, not as same-position prop sleepers.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because Arizona's secondary, already at 8.8 YPA to the left with Melton or Baker inactive, let Waddle turn the 102 air yards he has been wasting into one 40-yard shot and a 60-yard day, while Higgins' four-game floor was the 57-yard chunk regressing and McBride/Wilson (31 and 27 targets) eating the chase throws once DEN's 37% blitz turned Brissett's dropbacks into a two-score clock game. The counter-case is stronger on the matchup than on the form, which is why Waddle is flagged rather than sized, and why a DEN WR over or a Love-out Allgeier over was not added to paper over it.
slip_story: One story: DEN leads a 44.5 game and runs, ARI chases short. Stack is Waddle recyds under with Higgins recyds over. Do not add a game over, a Waddle or Sutton over, or a Wilson over that needs Surtain out. Dobbins rush over would fit the clock-kill half but the 48.5 number is a coin flip, so it stays off. Allgeier over needs the opposite backfield script from a trailing dog. No TDs, one market per player.
